resource.name: bng://manifest
resource.description: Controller manifest with capabilities and dependencies

resource.name: bng://namespaces
resource.description: All Kubernetes namespaces visible to the controller — useful for discovering where BNG target CRs may live

resource.name: bng://targets
resource.description: All monitored BNG targets (devices and hosts) — name, address, hostname, kind, namespace

resource.name: bng://targets/devices
resource.description: All NetworkDeviceTarget CRs with full spec and status

resource.name: bng://targets/hosts
resource.description: All NetworkHostTarget CRs with full spec and status

resource.name: bng://health/summary
resource.description: Real-time overall BNG health status — aggregated across all metric categories (CPU, memory, SRRP, FP resources, subscribers). To be implemented.

tool.name: bng_targets_by_label
tool.description: Monitored BNG targets filtered by Kubernetes label selector, e.g. `role=bng` or `env=prod,role=bng`

tool.name: read_bng_manifest
tool.description: Read the full BNG controller manifest including identity, capabilities, dependencies, and data sources

tool.name: discover_bng_capabilities
tool.description: Discover all BNG capabilities grouped by kind (resource, resource_template, tool, prompt)

tool.name: read_bng_resource
tool.description: Read any registered BNG resource by its `bng://` URI — supports static resources and parameterized templates

tool.name: bng_device_unavailability_map
tool.description: Check whether a BNG device was unreachable during a time window using absent_over_time() on CPU telemetry. Supports an optional start_time for historical queries.

tool.name: bng_device_cpu_usage
tool.description: Query CPU usage time series for a BNG device over a time window with summary statistics (avg, min, max) and quantiles (p80, p95, p98). Supports an optional start_time for historical queries.

tool.name: bng_device_memory_usage
tool.description: Query memory utilization (%) time series for a BNG device over a time window with summary statistics (avg, min, max) and quantiles (p80, p95, p98). Supports an optional start_time for historical queries.

tool.name: bng_device_hosts_stats
tool.description: Return peak and current IPv4/IPv6 subscriber host counts for a BNG device using instant queries on `state_subscriber_mgmt_statistics_total_hosts_peak_value` and `state_subscriber_mgmt_statistics_total_hosts_current_value`.

resource_template.name: bng://targets/devices/{namespace}
resource_template.description: NetworkDeviceTarget CRs filtered by Kubernetes namespace

resource_template.name: bng://targets/hosts/{namespace}
resource_template.description: NetworkHostTarget CRs filtered by Kubernetes namespace

prompt.name: bng-overview
prompt.description: Session bootstrap prompt — returns the BNG controller manifest and grouped capability summary so the LLM knows what is available
